calculation.expression: relative_momentum_20d * (1 if zscore(mean(US10Y_return_5d,CN10Y_return_5d),120) <= 0 else -1), lagged one completed day
calculation.description: Compute each asset's 20-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, then reverse the direction of the relative-momentum score when the lagged five-day average US10Y/CN10Y return is unusually positive (120-day z-score above zero).

validation.regime_notes: The available valid sample is concentrated in 2025-2027; 2026-07-01 onward has IC 0.04009 and ICIR 0.13319 over 138 observations. Earlier dates were unavailable for the conditioned calculation and should not be inferred. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
